svg.title: Gluten specific helper recognition after B cell antigen processing
svg.desc: The antigen captured by a BCR and the peptide recognized by a helper T cell need not be identical. The linkage is biological, not a claim that anti-TG2 IgA alone causes atrophy. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
